Strategy: Apply the gentle fifteen sweet band only for items smaller than thirty, keeping the mid penalty always on. Small items can use middle residuals flexibly, but the gate may rarely engage and the threshold is a guess.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if item < 30 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
